name: The Artisan of Glimmith: Lunar Lights
summary: Illuminate your mind in Lunar Lights, the dazzling new expansion for The Artisan of Glimmith. Celebrate the vibrant "Glass Lights Festival" as you master 12+ new puzzle rules designed to surprise and delight artisans of all experience levels. Step into the glow and unravel the festival's mysteries.
